description: Gate Info provides public, read-only cryptocurrency research data for ChatGPT: coin profiles, market overview and spot snapshots (including batch), Gate candlesticks, order book depth, and recent trades across spot, futures, delivery, and options where supported. No login, no account balances, no order placement or fund transfers. Data is informational only and is not investment advice. News/social tools are on Gate News; documentation tools are on a separate MCP server. Production MCP URL: https://api.gatemcp.ai/mcp/open/info (Streamable HTTP, no auth).

defaultPrompt: Using Gate Info, look up the public coin profile for BTC. If there are same-name candidates, say so.
Using Gate Info, give me the latest 5 one-hour BTC_USDT spot candlesticks.
